title: Speaking Practice 5 - Food and Cooking
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about food preferences and cooking habits.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Food and Cooking
stimuli.content: Answer questions about your food preferences and cooking habits.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about food and cooking.

questions.content: What kind of food do you like most?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I'm a big fan of Vietnamese cuisine, especially pho and banh mi. The combination of fresh herbs and rich broth is unbeatable.
explanation.tips: Name specific dishes and explain why

questions.content: Do you often cook at home?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Not as often as I'd like. I usually cook on weekends when I have more time, but during the week I tend to eat out.

questions.content: Have you ever tried cooking a foreign dish?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, I once tried making Japanese ramen from scratch. It took almost a whole day but the result was quite satisfying.

questions.content: Is street food popular in your country?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Absolutely! Street food is a huge part of Vietnamese culture. You can find amazing food vendors on practically every street corner.

questions.content: Do you think eating habits have changed in recent years?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Definitely. More young people now prefer fast food and delivery apps, which is quite different from the traditional family meals we used to have.
